versions.changelog: Add read-only exploration before policy setup, plain-language operator setup with agent-prepared files, and complete Claude package instructions. Existing coordinator and authority boundaries unchanged.
Clarify inspected evidence, current reassessment, changed destinations, and affirmative repeat support; distinguish raw-fact forward review from normalized-lane tests.

Contract 0.3.0: material uncertainty defaults to monitor; explicitly bounded small tests remain opt-in. Preserve adverse findings, enforce completed decision lanes, and clarify evidence availability. Includes 88 CLI regression cases.
Add general recipient custody/history guidance for irreversible transfers and zooidfund graph-history mapping.

- Initial release of the credibility-action-gate skill.
- Provides a structured workflow to evaluate claims before high-impact actions (e.g., funding, hiring, endorsements).
- Uses operator policy and multiple evidence lanes to produce an analysis-only action disposition.
- Action disposition guides eligibility (e.g., full, bounded, test, monitor, reject) without executing or making mission-specific decisions.
- Emphasizes separation of credibility analysis from mission fit and avoids default human escalation.
- Designed for portability: plain Markdown/JSON, no external or privileged dependencies.
